CNL_data: JSON scalars only. Never execute source/SQL. Preserve Unicode; no normalization. Reject invalid UTF-8 and unpaired surrogate escapes.
numeric: Retain signed64/unsigned64 JSON integer versus finite binary64 numeric category accepted by serde_json. Preserve f64 -0.0. Existing semantic argument validators determine the narrower signed32 runtime integer range. Do not coerce booleans, strings or null.

types.integer: signed32 JSON integer for runtime scalar constants
types.float: any finite JSON number, retain JSON representation
types.bytes: STANDARD Base64 JSON string decoding to1..1048576 bytes

defaults: optional v3+ null unless explicitly false for bool; no other defaults
production_python: output code only; parser/planner/inference do not invoke Python
